design system v1.7.1
updated 2026-10-19 · see CHANGELOG
bookkeepy · tokens v1
Quiet dark surfaces, small precise type, numbers first.
One token system for the shell, the board and every component. Primitives hold raw values; semantic roles (named after gpui-kit theme roles where one exists) are what components read; shell and type tokens compose them. Inter only. Phosphor icons, regular at rest and duotone when touched.
brightness is hierarchy
Surfaces differ by one step of lightness, not by borders or shadows. A hairline appears only where two regions of the same tone meet.
the number is the hero
Amounts get the largest, tightest type on a surface. Currency, labels and meta step back in size and tone.
calm until touched
Icons rest as thin regular strokes. Hover, press and selection fill them in as duotone, the only motion most surfaces have.
color carries meaning
Neutral by default. Hue appears only for money direction, status, time and data series, never as decoration.
01
Color · primitives
Raw values only. The neutral ramp is the backbone: every surface, text tone and border is one of these steps. Alpha whites build hover and selection layers that work on any surface.

Typography
Inter only. Every style is a bundle of size, line height, tracking, weight and paragraph spacing. Large type tightens, small type opens up. Amounts use Inter’s tabular figures (tnum) so columns of numbers line up.

Bookkeepy is offline first. Your books live in one file on this computer, and every change is written there before anything else happens.
Sync is optional. When you turn it on, changes travel encrypted and the local file stays the source of truth.

line-break rules
labels never wrap
Nav items, buttons, chips and tab labels stay on one line and truncate with an ellipsis at the end. The full text goes in a tooltip.
payees and people and their…
numbers never break
An amount, its sign and its currency are one unit. Use a no-break space before the currency and never hyphenate figures.
−1.000,00 RON
titles break by meaning
Headings may wrap to two lines; break between phrases, not inside a name. Avoid a single word on the last line.
Reconcile BT Pay
statement for October
body wraps at the measure
Reading text wraps at its measure token, left aligned and ragged right. Never justify; never hyphenate automatically.
Keep paragraphs short. Two to four lines read best on a dark surface.
04
Spacing
A 4 px base with half steps where small type needs them. Components read the semantic names: gaps say how related two things are, insets say how much room a container keeps at its edge.

05
Radius
Finite tiers, chosen by role. Nested shapes stay concentric: inner radius = outer radius − inset. The viewport (40) with its 24 padding gives cards 16, and a card’s 24 inset gives its controls 6–8.

Elevation, borders & focus
The base window is flat. Lightness separates regions; hairlines appear only where equal tones meet. Shadows exist only for things that float above the board.

07
Interaction states
Every interactive thing shows the same seven states the same way. Fills come from alpha layers so they work on the window, the main view and cards alike. Icons switch to duotone on hover, press and selection.

hover
alpha-4 layer, text to foreground, icon fills to duotone. Appears after 0 ms, leaves over duration-fast.
pressed
alpha-8 layer. No movement, no scale: the duotone fill is the feedback.
selected
alpha-8 on rows, alpha-12 on controls, accent-subtle only for filters that change data.
focus
2 px ring in ring color with 2 px offset, keyboard only. Never removed, never colored by status.
disabled
40% opacity of the whole control, cursor stays default, icon returns to regular.
loading
label stays, icon slot becomes spinner-gap; width never changes. Shown after delay-spinner.
08
Iconography
Phosphor only, imported from phosphor-icons/SVGs Flat. Every glyph exists twice: regular (rest, quiet, disabled) and the prebuilt duotone file (hover, pressed, selected, attention). Interaction swaps the variant with a duration-icon (160 ms) crossfade. Icons never sit on a background plate; the glyph alone carries the state.

09
Async & loading
Bookkeepy works async: imports, sync, recalculations. Loading is quiet and never jumps. Nothing appears before delay-spinner (300 ms); once shown it stays at least min-loading (500 ms) so it never flickers.
tokens v1.0.1
skeleton · first load
For content that has a shape: tables, cards, the overview. Bars match the real line heights; a highlight sweeps every skeleton-cycle (1.4 s).
spinner · an action is running
spinner-gap at icon size, duotone, rotating once per 900 ms. Replaces the icon in place; the label changes to the running verb.

progress · long work
Determinate when the total is known (import of 1.240 rows). Track and fill are neutral; color only on finish or failure.

Offline is normal, not an error. The status lives in the sidebar footer as one quiet line; it only takes color when something needs you.
